header.title: About Sciecola
header.subtitle: Advancing the UN Sustainable Development Goals through AI-powered research analytics.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.paragraph: We believe artificial intelligence can be a powerful force for positive change. Our mission is to accelerate progress toward the UN Sustainable Development Goals by making research impact more visible, measurable, and actionable.

global.title: Global Impact
global.description: Empowering researchers worldwide to understand and strengthen their contribution to sustainable development.

ai.title: AI Innovation
ai.description: Using state-of-the-art AI to deliver accurate and comprehensive SDG classifications.

community.title: Community Driven
community.description: Building a collaborative platform connecting researchers, institutions, and policy makers.

tech.title: Our Technology
tech.subtitle: Our SDG classification system combines several AI approaches for comprehensive, accurate analysis:

keyword.title: Keyword Analysis
keyword.description: Advanced semantic matching against a comprehensive SDG vocabulary and taxonomy.

similarity.title: Similarity Mapping
similarity.description: Deep learning models understanding contextual relationships between research and SDG themes.

substantive.title: Substantive Analysis
substantive.description: Evaluating research depth and methodological relevance to specific SDG targets and indicators.

causal.title: Causal Inference
causal.description: Detecting causal relationships and evidence of direct impact on SDG outcomes.

stats.title: Impact in Numbers
stats.subtitle: Live indicators from our database — updated as the platform grows.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: We believe in open, explainable AI that researchers can trust and understand.

collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.description: We work closely with the research community to continuously improve our platform.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: We are committed to environmental responsibility in all our operations and decisions.

equity.title: Equity
equity.description: We strive to make our tools accessible to researchers and institutions worldwide.

history.title: Platform History
history.subtitle: Read the platform's journey and milestones.

team.title: Meet the Team
team.subtitle: Get to know the people building Sciecola.
